restaurant_name: Animal Army Hospital โรงพยาบาลสัตว์ แอนิมัล อาร์มี่
text:
I can highly recommend Animal Army in Pattaya. They are not only a dog rescue and animal welfare organization, but also operate a fully licensed veterinary clinic in Pattaya (Najomtien) that treats both rescue animals and privately owned pets.

The veterinary team is incredibly friendly, professional, and experienced. The prices are very affordable compared to many other vets in Pattaya, while the quality of care is outstanding. Whether you need routine treatment, emergency care, surgery, or help with an injured animal, they genuinely care about every case.

What makes Animal Army special is that they actively rescue injured and abandoned street dogs and provide life-saving medical treatment. If you find a sick or injured stray dog in Pattaya, they are one of the first places you should contact. They also help with adoptions, including international adoptions for people who want to give Thai rescue dogs a forever home abroad.

I also find some of the negative reviews a little unfair. Animal Army is a charity organization that relies heavily on donations, volunteers, and a limited number of staff. Expecting a rescue organization to have unlimited resources, be available 24/7, or instantly respond to every situation is simply unrealistic. They are doing an incredible amount of work with the resources they have. So please be nice!

TL;DR
An amazing organization, a fantastic veterinary clinic, and a team that truly makes a difference for animals, pets, and street dogs in Thailand.
